field.label: Store Avatar URL
field.comment: Leave empty to use the store logo. Accepts an absolute URL or a static asset reference such as Vendor_Module::images/avatar.png

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: When disabled, the avatar endpoint returns 404 and templates fall back to initials.

field.label: Cache TTL (seconds)
field.comment: Local avatar cache lifetime and browser max-age. Default: 2592000 (30 days).

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: When enabled, new review submissions containing a blacklisted keyword or domain are rejected with the message below. Admin edits are never blocked.

field.label: Keyword Blacklist
field.comment: One entry per line, case-insensitive substring match anywhere in the review text. Empty lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

field.label: Domain Blacklist
field.comment: One entry per line. Accepts bare domains (example.com), URLs (https://example.com/x) and www. links. Matches wherever the domain appears: links, email addresses, www. prefixes.

field.label: Domain Whitelist
field.comment: Same format as the blacklist. Whitelisted domains (including their subdomains) are never blocked. Use for domains that appear in the blacklist but are safe, e.g. allow example.com while spam.example.com is blocked.

field.label: Whitelist Priority
field.comment: Domain only: whitelisted domains are exempt from the blacklist but keywords still apply. Full bypass: any whitelisted domain in the text skips all remaining moderation.

field.label: Rejection Message
field.comment: Shown to the customer when a review is rejected. Default: Your review contains content that is not allowed.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Send the reviewer an email when their approved review contains a store answer. Only applies when the review nickname is an email address; each review notifies at most once.

field.label: Email Template
field.comment: Template used for the reply notification email. Default: Giztop Review Reply Notification.

field.label: Send Emails From
field.comment: Email identity used as sender when the custom sender email below is empty. Resolved per store scope.

field.label: Custom Sender Email
field.comment: Optional. Overrides the email identity above. Leave empty to use the selected identity address.

field.label: Custom Sender Name
field.comment: Optional. Used together with the custom sender email. Leave empty to fall back to the Store Name.

group.label: Human Verification (Cloudflare Turnstile)
group.comment: Adds a Cloudflare Turnstile challenge to the review form. Stays completely invisible to customers until both keys are filled in and Enabled is set to Yes.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Requires both Site Key and Secret Key. If either key is empty the challenge is skipped and review submission behaves exactly as before.

field.label: Site Key
field.comment: Public key rendered into the widget (Cloudflare dashboard > Turnstile > your site).

field.label: Secret Key
field.comment: Private key used for server-side siteverify. Stored encrypted. Leave the asterisks untouched to keep the stored value; clear the field to remove it.

field.label: Behaviour When Cloudflare Is Unreachable
field.comment: Only affects network/transport errors (timeout, DNS, TLS). An explicit Cloudflare rejection always rejects the review.

field.label: Expected Hostname (advanced)
field.comment: Leave EMPTY in production: the current store host is then required to match the token hostname. Only set a value to accept a different host, e.g. "example.com" while testing with the official Cloudflare test keys. A value left here by mistake weakens the check - restore it to empty after testing.

group.label: Review Webhook (RabbitMQ)
group.comment: Publishes a signed JSON event to an external endpoint whenever a customer submits a review. Delivery is asynchronous: the event is queued on RabbitMQ and delivered by the giztop.review.webhook consumer service.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Requires an Endpoint URL. When disabled nothing is published and the queue stays empty.

field.label: Delivery Channel
field.comment: Generic JSON: sends the documented payload with an X-Giztop-Signature header. Feishu / Lark custom bot: sends an interactive card and signs the request with timestamp + sign (the Signing Secret is then used as the bot secret).

field.label: Endpoint URL
field.comment: Must be https:// and must not resolve to a private or reserved address (SSRF protection). Validated on save and again on every delivery.

field.label: Signing Secret
field.comment: Used for the X-Giztop-Signature header: sha256=HMAC-SHA256(raw body, secret). Stored encrypted. Leave the asterisks untouched to keep the stored value; clear the field to remove it.

field.label: Feishu Card Title
field.comment: Only used when Delivery Channel = Feishu. Supports the same {{variables}} as the card body. Example: New review: {{product_name}}

field.label: Feishu Card Body
Request Timeout (seconds)
field.comment: Total cURL timeout per delivery attempt; the connect timeout is fixed at 3 seconds. Default: 10.

field.label: Maximum Delivery Attempts
field.comment: After the last failed attempt the payload is parked on the giztop.review.webhook.error queue. Backoff is 2, 4, 8, 16, then 30 seconds. Default: 5.

field.label: Include Review Text
field.comment: When disabled the payload carries an empty detail field. Default: Yes.

field.label: Review Text Max Length
field.comment: Characters. Longer bodies are truncated and flagged with detail_truncated=true. Default: 1000.

field.label: Include Reviewer Email (plaintext)
field.comment: Privacy sensitive. When disabled (default) the payload only carries nickname_masked (j***@g***.com). Enable only if the receiving system has a documented need and a lawful basis.

field.label: User-Agent
field.comment: Sent with every delivery so the receiver can identify the source. Default: Giztop-ReviewEnhance/1.0.
